A [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] '''cruiser''' was used by the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At least one [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was present in the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]] shortly prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] as the Alliance [[Navy/Legends|navy]] gathered its forces.
{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ROTJ-Rebel-Fleet-Storyboard.png|thumb|left|240px|The cruiser was drawn for a ''Return of the Jedi'' storyboard featuring a sequence of the Alliance Fleet.]]
The Mon Calamari cruiser debuted in {{Film|VI}}, which debuted in [[1983]]. The vessel appeared in the assortment of Rebel starships prior to the Battle of Endor and was located in the background.<ref name="Episode VI" /> According to author [[Paul Duncan]], concept art of the cruiser was created for ''Return of the Jedi'', and that there were images of the ship's miniature model in the [[Lucasfilm Archives]]. The cruiser's model was featured in storyboards,<ref name="Tweet 1">{{Twitter|kershed|status/1665426997340692480|[[Paul Duncan]]|date=2023-06-04|quote=There are images of the model ship in the archives, but I did not have space to include any in the book. I do, however, have concept art and storyboards with the cruiser.|archivedate=20230604190811}}</ref> one of which was included in ''[[Star Wars Storyboards: The Original Trilogy]]''.<ref name="Storyboards">''[[Star Wars Storyboards: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref>
